scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would be fatal. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I yell at my aunt until she takes the medication, my aunt will continue to live. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a fatal seizure and die.
choice: I decide to yell at my aunt until she takes the medication
outcomes: My aunt avoids a fatal seizure
I feel distressed from yelling at my aunt
My aunt has difficulty at my aunt's desk job
